design: Exploratory, 30 seeds, 3 task geometries, 6 mixed batches of 5, one RGB and independent RGB repeat or overhead acquisition. Select highest pre-score per batch at 3/5 or 4/5, or measure all. Compare full vs selected acceptance and always-switch at equal lists. Primary outcome strict seating; descriptive counts only. Visible color fiducials and camera model available to all methods; geometry-assisted acceptance uses the second view only when acquired. No training. All scenes retained.
